description: Placard / label codes for a hazardous material from the US DOT table (49 CFR 172.101, eCFR), by UN number (e.g. 1203) or name fragment: label codes, hazard class and packing group. Returns the label code numbers as written in the table; it does not give the placard artwork or emergency response guide entries. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

q.description: 4-digit UN number (1203) or a name fragment of 3 to 60 characters
